//@version=6
indicator("V52 kc-series-mult", calc_bars_count=32)
candidateArgument = (bar_index % 4) + 1
[middle, upper, lower] = ta.kc(series=close, length=3, mult=candidateArgument, useTrueRange=true)
plot(middle, "MIDDLE")
plot(upper, "UPPER")
plot(lower, "LOWER")
plot(candidateArgument, "ARGUMENT")
plot(bar_index, "SOURCE_INDEX")
